items.name: AML/CFT (FATF Recommendations)
items.version: current (continuously amended; last major update Oct 2023)
items.scope: Customer due diligence, ongoing monitoring, suspicious transaction reporting, and record-keeping baseline that national AML laws implement.
items.notes: FATF Recommendations are not directly binding; they are implemented through national law (e.g. EU AMLR/AMLD, US BSA).

items.name: EU Anti-Money Laundering Regulation (AMLR)
items.scope: Directly-applicable EU-wide CDD, beneficial-ownership, and reporting rules for obliged entities, phased in through the new AMLA authority.
items.notes: Part of the 2024 EU AML package; applicability dates are staged — verify current phase.

items.name: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA)
items.scope: CDD, currency transaction reports (CTR), and suspicious activity reports (SAR) for US-regulated financial institutions.

items.name: PSD2 Strong Customer Authentication
items.scope: Two-factor authentication for electronic payments and regulated open-banking access to account data/payment initiation.
items.notes: A successor PSD3 directive plus a Payment Services Regulation (PSR) were proposed by the European Commission in 2023; legislative status changes over time and must be re-verified.

provenance.notes: PSD3/PSR status is in legislative progress as of the last verification; treat as low-confidence for anything beyond current PSD2 text.

items.name: PCI DSS
items.scope: Secure handling, storage, and transmission of cardholder data for any system that issues or processes card payments.
items.notes: Contractual via card-network rules, not government law.

items.name: GDPR
items.scope: Lawful basis, minimization, and subject rights for personal data collected during onboarding, KYC, and transaction history.
